authority: XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.1: "The decimal digit family of a decimal format is the sequence of ten digits with consecutive Unicode codepoints starting with the character that is the value of the zero-digit property", so the family here is A-J: 7 is "H", and the second mandatory digit pads with the zero digit "A". F&O also requires zero-digit to be "a character in Unicode category Nd with decimal digit value 0 (zero)", which "A" is not — but jsonata.org's own worked example uses U+245F (category Cn), pinned as function-formatNumber/case011, so a non-Nd zero-digit is documented JSONata behaviour and only the family construction is left to derive.
